description: This file defines platform detection logic for different operating systems and architectures, including functions to determine the host platform and its support status, as well as mappings to short platform identifiers.

methods.name: calculatePlatform
methods.description: Determines the current host platform and whether it is officially supported based on OS and distribution info.

methods.name: toShortPlatform
methods.description: Converts a detailed host platform string into a simplified short platform identifier.
